name: llm-call/openrouter
description: OpenRouter inference with an explicit model and a local secret reference from the environment or the macOS Keychain. This is not the current CLI agent.

secretSource.notes: env | keychain. Default env. keychain reads the key from the local macOS Keychain (service com.qfactory.q-core.openrouter, account openrouter:<keyRef>; store it with q-core auth set openrouter); the key never appears in the workflow, environment or run record.

keyRef.notes: Uppercase secret alias, default OPENROUTER_API_KEY. With secretSource env it names the environment variable; with keychain it names the Keychain entry.

json.notes: When format: json, the output is the parsed object instead of {text, model}.

value: OpenRouter inference with an explicit model and a local secret reference from the environment or the macOS Keychain. This is not the current CLI agent.
